text.en: Clients praise trainers Maddie, Anna, and Erin for their attentive, empathetic coaching style and deep behavioral expertise. Owners appreciate that sessions are supportive rather than judgmental, offering real-time problem solving and clear instruction for owners.

Reviewers highlight remarkable progress with challenging issues such as separation anxiety, urban noise phobias, and leash reactivity. Clients share that structured homework notes and practical cues enabled dogs to disengage from distractions and gain confidence.

Pet parents value the positive reinforcement approach tailored to anxious rescues, puppies, and dogs with intense sensitivities in city environments. Reviews note that dogs quickly warm to the trainers, becoming receptive to learning without fear or frustration.

q.en: Can they assist with severe separation anxiety?

a.en: Yes, clients report notable improvements in home-alone departures when working with specialized trainer guidance.

q.en: Do they provide written notes after sessions?

a.en: Yes, reviews highlight receiving thorough follow-up summaries outlining exercises, concepts, and weekly practice tips.

q.en: How do they help dogs manage urban noise and city stress?

a.en: Trainers provide scaffolded exposure techniques and disengagement strategies to help nervous dogs navigate busy streets.
